description: Puglia publishes activity spaces within sports facilities. CSV, JSON and nine XML parts belong to this one source-defined inventory. It describes physical sports spaces; the short metadata does not establish field names, surface dimensions, sport types, capacities or relationships to individual facilities. Separate owner/operator information is a different registry object, and exact cross-table keys have not been verified. No parts are counted as independent datasets. Coverage is Puglia, Italy. The licence declared by native metadata is IODL-2.0. The public catalogue provides descriptive metadata and the listed distribution links. Costs, access conditions for later file use and present completeness remain unknown. The supplied facts come from source descriptions and distribution labels; data values and file contents were not inspected. No specific simulation method is documented. Related resources may overlap this inventory or time period, but no further exact relationship is established by the inspected metadata.
